archetype: LUXURY & PERFORMANCE TECH (Deep Obsidian, Luminous Teal, Coral Red Accent)
color_scheme: Dark-by-default with rich deep navy-black tones, luminous electric teal highlights, and warm coral/terracotta accents inspired by the brand mark

typography.font_family_sans: Plus Jakarta Sans Variable, system-ui, sans-serif

rules.headings: Lora serif for major editorial titles and logo mark ('KALYANI'), with high contrast weight and tracking-tight
rules.subheadings_overlines: Plus Jakarta Sans with uppercase letterspacing tracking-[0.2em] for 'TECHNOLOGIES' and section tags
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans for high legibility, line-height leading-relaxed, text-[#94A3B8] to text-[#CBD5E1]

entry_surfaces./: editorial split hero — left: kinetic headline with line-by-line reveal & glowing teal 4-pointed star badge + dual CTAs; right: interactive 3D particle constellation / code architecture showcase widget with live system metrics

visual_enhancers.brand_mark: 4-pointed geometric star/sparkle SVG (filled luminous teal #14B8A6 / #2DD4BF) with soft glow drop-shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(20,184,166,0.5)]
visual_enhancers.background_textures: Subtle SVG noise grain overlay (opacity 0.03) across all deep sections; radial teal (#14B8A6/10) and coral (#FF5A36/08) ambient light bleeds
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam_cards: 1px borders with border-[#1E293B] transitioning to border-[#14B8A6]/60 on hover with subtle glow
visual_enhancers.editorial_marquee: Slow, elegant drift marquee for tech stack & client trust badges using Plus Jakarta Sans + subtle mono separators

grids_and_layouts.hero_section: 12-column grid. Left 7 cols for narrative & primary actions, right 5 cols for interactive architecture showcase & live metrics
grids_and_layouts.services_bento_grid: MODE A Tetris Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6): Card 1 (Custom Software Architecture - 8 cols, row-span-2 with code visual), Card 2 (AI/ML Engineering - 4 cols), Card 3 (Cloud & DevOps - 4 cols), Card 4 (Web & Mobile Apps - 6 cols), Card 5 (UI/UX Engineering - 6 cols), Card 6 (IT Consulting & Strategy - 12 cols banner)
grids_and_layouts.stats_section: 4-column high density stat counters with crisp top borders and +99.9% uptime, 45+ enterprise clients, 120+ launched platforms, 15ms avg latency
grids_and_layouts.portfolio_showcase: Asymmetric staggered showcase with interactive project filter tabs (Enterprise SaaS, FinTech, AI Engines, Cloud Native)
grids_and_layouts.contact_section: Split layout (5 cols company info, Bangalore/Hyderabad presence, SLA guarantee + 7 cols interactive inquiry form with validation connecting to FastAPI backend)

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration for weighted, luxurious momentum
motion.entrance_reveals: motion/react staggerContainer with subtle translateY: [20, 0] and opacity: [0, 1], ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]
motion.interactive_cards: Hover tilt/lift transform: translateY(-4px) with transition: 'transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 0.25s ease'
motion.star_pulse: Slow breathing rotation (360deg over 30s) or sparkle scale micro-animation on logo mark

accessibility.contrast_compliance: All text tokens exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio on deep navy surfaces (#F1F5F9 and #CBD5E1 on #070B12 and #0B132B)
accessibility.reduced_motion: All motion/react components respect prefers-reduced-motion via Framer Motion configuration
accessibility.testing_ids: Every interactive button, link, tab, input, and submit element must declare explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-contact-btn', data-testid='contact-form-submit')

team_and_collaboration.description: Collaborative engineering team discussing software architecture
Lead engineer developing full-stack code on dual monitors

tech_and_ui.description: Next-gen AI assistant and platform interface

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.html default HTML tag with <html class='dark'> and set title to 'Kalyani Technologies | Enterprise Software & AI Engineering'. Add SVG favicon representing the 4-pointed teal star mark.

2. In frontend/src/index.css: import '@fontsource-variable/lora', '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans', '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'. Configure @theme with --font-heading: 'Lora Variable', serif and --font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif. Apply color tokens from this specification.

3. Build the Brand Header with the exact Kalyani Technologies logo: 4-pointed sparkle SVG mark in teal (#14B8A6), 'KALYANI' in serif (Lora), and 'TECHNOLOGIES' below in coral uppercase with letterspacing tracking-[0.25em]. Provide smooth navigation links (Services, Solutions, Work, About, Contact) and a primary CTA 'Start a Project'.

4. Implement the Hero Section: Asymmetric layout with badge 'Next-Gen Software Engineering', bold headline with highlighted words in Teal & Coral, subtext, dual CTA buttons ('Explore Capabilities' and 'Schedule Consultation'), and an interactive Live Architecture Terminal widget with animated logs, uptime, and latency indicators.
5. Implement Bento Grid for 6 core services (Custom Software, AI/ML, Cloud Native, Web & Mobile, UI/UX, IT Consulting) with interactive hover cards, feature badges, and micro-metric displays.
6. Build a live, working Contact & Project Estimation module that submits to the FastAPI backend at POST /api/inquiries, displaying Sonner toast notifications on success.
7. Include Testimonials, Enterprise Tech Stack slow marquee, Stats counter, and a massive editorial Footer.
8. Ensure every button, input, tab, and card has explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.
